title: IBN professional data-selling landing page with WhatsApp contact CTA

requirements.summary: Create an IBN-branded application shell with header branding and page metadata that positions the app as a professional data-selling business.
acceptanceCriteria: The app header/nav prominently displays the text "IBN".
Browser tab/page title includes "IBN".
Primary landing view communicates that IBN sells data (English copy).

file_operations.description: Ensure document title and basic metadata include "IBN" and reflect a professional data-selling application (English).
Create the root app component that renders an IBN-branded application shell (header + landing content + footer) and sets up the main layout structure.

Add a reusable header component that prominently displays "IBN" and supports rendering the generated logo asset. Use shadcn-ui primitives (e.g., Button) for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement a clean landing page layout with hero, description, and above-the-fold WhatsApp call-to-action.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing page has distinct sections (hero + description + call-to-action).
All user-facing text is in English.
The primary call-to-action is clearly visible without scrolling on common laptop screen sizes.

file_operations.description: Implement a single-page landing layout with distinct hero, brief description, and a prominent WhatsApp CTA visible above the fold. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Card) for consistent structure and spacing; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the landing page component into the app so it is the primary view users see.

requirements.summary: Add a WhatsApp contact button/link that opens a chat for 09033449260 across desktop and mobile layouts.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking/tapping the WhatsApp button navigates to a WhatsApp chat link.
The displayed contact number is exactly "09033449260".
The WhatsApp link is available on both desktop and mobile layouts.

file_operations.description: Add a small utility to centralize the WhatsApp phone number ("09033449260") and build the WhatsApp chat URL used throughout the UI.

Create a reusable WhatsApp CTA component (button/link) that displays the number exactly as "09033449260" and navigates to the WhatsApp chat link. Use shadcn-ui Button for consistent interactions and focus/hover states; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Use the shared WhatsAppCTA component in the hero section so the primary CTA is prominent on both desktop and mobile layouts.

requirements.summary: Apply a coherent professional visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, interaction states) consistently across the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: UI uses a consistent color palette, typography scale, and spacing rhythm across the app.
Buttons/links/sections share consistent styling and interaction states (hover/focus).
Design avoids default/unstyled template appearance and feels intentionally branded.

file_operations.description: Define global theme tokens (CSS variables used by Tailwind/shadcn), base typography, and consistent spacing defaults to achieve a professional branded look (no changes to immutable files).
Extend/adjust the Tailwind theme (e.g., brand color tokens, font families) to support a consistent IBN design system across components and sections.

Apply consistent section styling, typography hierarchy, and responsive spacing using the established theme. Use shadcn-ui components where appropriate to maintain a consistent design system; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Align header styling with the global theme, ensuring consistent typography, spacing, and interaction states (e.g., focus-visible styles on links/buttons).

requirements.summary: Add a static, code-editable Data Plans section listing at least 3 example offerings (name, price, description).
acceptanceCriteria: A section exists that lists at least 3 example offerings with name, price, and description.
Offerings are rendered from a single in-code data structure (not hardcoded repeatedly).
No checkout/payment is required to view offerings.

file_operations.description: Create a Data Plans section that renders at least 3 offerings from a single in-code array (name, price, description). Use shadcn-ui Card components (or equivalent) for consistent presentation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the Data Plans section into the landing page below the hero/description to support browsing offerings without any checkout flow.

requirements.summary: Add a footer with basic business/contact text and a repeated WhatsApp link for 09033449260.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer is present on the main page.
Footer contains a WhatsApp link that works and references "09033449260".
Footer content is in English.

file_operations.description: Create a footer component with English business/contact copy and a repeated WhatsApp link using the shared WhatsAppCTA/link behavior. Use shadcn-ui primitives for consistent typography/link styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the footer into the app shell so it appears on the main page beneath the landing content.

requirements.summary: Add generated brand assets (IBN logo and hero background) as static public images and render them in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Logo image is displayed in the header and/or hero section.
Hero background/illustration (if used) loads locally as a static asset (not via backend).
All generated images are stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and referenced from there.

file_operations.description: Add the generated IBN wordmark logo asset as a static file at the required path.
Add the generated subtle abstract tech hero background asset as a static file at the required path.
Render the logo image from frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-logo.dim_512x512.png in the header alongside the "IBN" brand text.

Render the hero background/illustration using the local static asset frontend/public/assets/generated/ibn-hero-bg.dim_1600x900.png (e.g., as a decorative background behind the hero section) while keeping text readable and professional.
